index., especially stories about real people,: , especially stories about real people, their lives, and things that are almost too strange to be true. I enjoy learning something new and seeing the world from a different perspective. I also like filming and experimenting with video myself. My favorites are the ones that leave me thinking long after the credits roll.
A few details are enough to get started.
index.A little about my approach, experience,: A little about my approach, experience, and how I work with teams.
index.A lot of my work involves products that: A lot of my work involves products that already have established interfaces, workflows, and design systems. I first understand how everything works, then figure out what actually needs changing. I don't see a reason to redesign everything when a smaller change can solve the problem.
index.Email works best, but you can also reach: Email works best, but you can also reach me on Telegram or give me a call.
index.Feel free to reach out. I'll be happy to: Feel free to reach out. I'll be happy to answer by email.
index.Have a role or project in mind?: Have a role or project in mind?
index.How do I approach improving existing pro: How do I approach improving existing products?
index.How do I collaborate with developers and: How do I collaborate with developers and teams?
index.How do I test and improve my designs?: How do I test and improve my designs?
index.How do I work independently on projects?: How do I work independently on projects?
index.I can take a task from understanding the: I can take a task from understanding the requirements to reviewing the final interface. I've worked on complex B2B platforms, CRMs, dashboards, and data-heavy interfaces. I'm comfortable designing from scratch or improving existing products.
index.I can work through a task on my own, gat: I can work through a task on my own, gather missing information, explore different solutions, and prepare designs for development. I also stay in touch with the team, discuss constraints, and share progress along the way.
index.I design web and mobile products, from C: I design web and mobile products, from CRMs and logistics platforms to fintech. I enjoy untangling complex workflows and making them easier to use.
index.I start by understanding the problem and: I start by understanding the problem and who I'm solving it for. I look at user flows, product data, research findings, and feedback. I don't stick to my first idea if I find a better way to solve the problem.
index.I use user interviews, usability testing: I use user interviews, usability testing, product analytics, and feedback to check whether a solution works. I also review the implemented interface and make adjustments when something doesn't work as expected.
index.I work directly with product managers, a: I work directly with product managers, analysts, developers, and clients. We discuss requirements, explore solutions, and work through technical constraints. I stay involved during development, answer questions, and review the final implementation.
index.I've worked on B2B SaaS, CRMs, fintech,: I've worked on B2B SaaS, CRMs, fintech, logistics, e-commerce, and mobile apps. Figma is my main design tool, including components, variables, and prototyping. I also use ChatGPT, Claude, and Codex to explore ideas, solve problems, and build interactive prototypes.
index.Interactive preview of the amoCRM deal m: Interactive preview of the amoCRM deal management case study.
index.Looking for a designer or have a project: Looking for a designer or have a project in mind? I'd love to hear from you.
index.Maxim always wanted to understand why we: Maxim always wanted to understand why we were building something, not just what needed to be designed. He wasn't afraid to suggest a different approach when something didn't feel right. I also appreciated how involved he stayed during development, reviewing the final interfaces and helping make sure everything worked as intended.
index.Maxim did a great job rethinking our sho: Maxim did a great job rethinking our shopping experience. He noticed little things we'd overlooked and found ways to make the buying process much easier to follow.
index.Maxim has a great eye for design. Someti: Maxim has a great eye for design. Sometimes a couple of references were enough for him to understand exactly where we wanted to go.
index.Maxim has a talent for turning scattered: Maxim has a talent for turning scattered ideas into clean, well-structured interfaces. He thinks about how things work, not just how they look.
index.Maxim quickly got up to speed with sever: Maxim quickly got up to speed with several complex B2B products. What I appreciated most was that he didn't just focus on making things look better. He took the time to understand how people actually used the systems and came back with thoughtful, practical solutions.
Maxim was a great addition to the team. He was open to feedback, asked questions when something wasn't clear, and always followed through. Just really easy to work with.
index.One thing I really liked about Maxim was: One thing I really liked about Maxim was how independently he worked. We could discuss a task, agree on the main requirements, and trust him to figure out the details. If he spotted a problem or had a better idea, he'd bring it up rather than just following instructions.
index.Redesigned key shopping flows, from sign: Redesigned key shopping flows, from signing in to checkout, with a focus on removing unnecessary steps. I also built a UI kit and design tokens from scratch for desktop and mobile.
index.Studied communications, media, and desig: Studied communications, media, and design. This is where I became interested in how visuals shape the way people understand information and how even complex ideas can be explained simply.
Tell me what you have in mind...
index.Thanks for reaching out! I'll read your: Thanks for reaching out! I'll read your message and get back to you soon. Talk to you then!

index.Worked on both the public website and th: Worked on both the public website and the CRM itself, from pricing and integrations to subscriptions and payments. I also created 40+ design-system components and reviewed implementations with developers before release.
index.Worked on four B2B products, bringing th: Worked on four B2B products, bringing their interfaces together through a shared design system. I also ran user interviews, usability tests, and used support feedback to find and fix problems in everyday workflows.
index.Worked on web and mobile interfaces, fro: Worked on web and mobile interfaces, from user flows to interactive prototypes. I also designed UI components and worked with developers to bring designs into the final product.
index.Working with Maxim is always fun. He bri: Working with Maxim is always fun. He brings fresh ideas to the table, and rarely stops at the first one.
index.and everything around it. I follow runwa: and everything around it. I follow runway shows, new collections, and interesting brands. I especially enjoy discovering unusual pieces and seeing how styles change over time. I can easily spend half an hour looking through a collection, even when I know I'm not going to buy anything.
index.since I was a kid, and I still love gett: since I was a kid, and I still love getting lost in new worlds, exploring every corner, and finding little details most people might miss. I often tell myself I'll play for just an hour, and somehow it's already 3 AM.

shable.I designed Shable’s navigation from scra: I designed Shable’s navigation from scratch, defining the screen hierarchy and how users move from the home page into different shopping sections.
shable.I designed a mobile fashion shopping app: I designed a mobile fashion shopping app, working on catalog navigation, product discovery, and product details. I also developed a consistent visual style across the key shopping screens.
shable.I designed product lists with a clear hi: I designed product lists with a clear hierarchy of images, prices, and key details, making it easier to scan different items and explore the ones worth a closer look.
shable.I designed product pages that bring toge: I designed product pages that bring together images, pricing, available sizes and colors, descriptions, and customer ratings, giving shoppers the information they need to evaluate an item.
shable.I designed the main shopping screens, in: I designed the main shopping screens, including product options, favorites, and reusable interface elements for a consistent mobile experience.
shable.I kept size and color selection alongsid: I kept size and color selection alongside essential product details, allowing shoppers to explore different options without leaving the page.
shable.I organized the catalog around Men, Wome: I organized the catalog around Men, Women, and Brands, giving shoppers clear starting points based on what they want to explore.
shable.I separated the app’s main navigation fr: I separated the app’s main navigation from catalog browsing. The bottom navigation provides access to key sections, while category cards guide shoppers toward relevant products. This keeps the home screen focused on discovery without overwhelming it with options.
shable.I structured the experience around key s: I structured the experience around key shopping tasks, defining how users move between categories, product lists, and item details.
